run_parallel_ensemble_training: run parallel training of multiple MLP models using functorch vmap to batch gradient updates
create_spiral_dataset: create a synthetic spiral classification dataset with configurable noise and rotations for binary classification
build_mlp_classifier: build a two-layer MLP classifier with configurable hidden dimensions and output classes using PyTorch nn.Module
train_functional_model: train a functional model using make_functional and grad_and_value to compute gradients and update weights manually
init_ensemble_weights: initialize batched weights for an ensemble of MLP models using combine_state_for_ensemble for parallel training
